mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_invitation (kb_id, inviter_id, invitee_id, role, status, created_at, updated_at, expired_at) VALUES (#{kbId}, #{inviterId}, #{inviteeId}, #{role}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{expiredAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, kb_id, inviter_id, invitee_id, role, status, created_at, updated_at, expired_at FROM kb_invitation WHERE invitee_id = #{inviteeId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC
